notes.title: Let's Ride the Waves! "Sea of Craft" Official Version is Out Today!
notes.notes:
Dear Captains!
The official version of "Sea of Craft" is released today~ 
After many days and nights of polishing, the Bilan Ocean is yours to explore! For the first week of release, enjoy a 10% discount. An adventurous voyage awaits you, Captain! Through wind and waves, let's unlock a new adventure together!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/a0b42b51364c596e02721f3f701bb8f9fd11d8bf.jpg[/img]

Sea of Craft is a maritime sandbox construction game built on realistic simulated physics. Build and share unique vehicles in real time using a state-of-the-art real-time blueprint and building system. Explore exciting single player levels and climb to the top of the leaderboards, or hunt down pirates on the Open Sea and claim their pilfered treasure. Recruit your friends to join you in fierce online multiplayer naval battles!


Unlock Your Imagination, Build Anything
Set the stage for moments of inspiration in Sea of Craft's sophisticated, freewheeling physics-based building system. Build your very own unique vehicles using a range of over 100 distinct shipbuilding parts from categories such as hull, mobility, weapons and sprays. You can build anything, be it a colossal seafaring frigate, a desert-crawling tank, a towering building, a majestic winged dragon or a sinister deep-sea abomination. The official version introduces new automated shipbuilding parts including flight parts to take you to the skies. Embark on a thrilling journey of discovery by sea, land and air!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/36410d9feae1d93d5bad1ebeb9aa4d97376f3155.jpg[/img]

Exciting Gameplay, Immersive Adventures
The official version offers a wide range of exciting gameplay including absorbing construction gameplay, immersive single player, multiplayer mayhem, and large-map PvE, all taking place in a boundless ocean world ripe for discovery. Play football on the water's surface or rescue cute crocodiles in a series of captivating and extraordinary themed levels. Put your building brain to work on how to crack the fastest times on the leaderboards. Take to the high seas and face off against pirates, search for mysterious treasures and tweak your creations along the way. Or become king of the sea in intense PvP naval battles, racing, defense and fishing, where guns and speed are your best friends!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/46c5c9b5a8812766e3f68bd0c8586c9c9e9f4a17.jpg[/img]

The ocean environments of Sea of Craft are exquisitely rendered in next-generation graphics quality and brought to life with bespoke sound design. The official version looks and feels smoother and more realistic than ever following optimisations in performance, stability, fluency and interactive feedback from the Early Access version. Never has an ocean journey commenced with such splendour!

notes.title: New voyage on the horizon! Sea of Craft full release arrives this March 10th!
notes.notes:
[b]Ahoy captains! Long time no see![/b]
Our development team has big news to share with you today - the full release of Sea of Craft is coming on March 10th! Following meticulous polishing and optimization of the Early Access build, the team are proud to unveil new and improved shipbuilding parts, game modes and other features!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/c47c6ee0f7717f5bb0b85bf58195b6144efd5888.jpg[/img]

[b]Realistic Physics, Freewheeling Building[/b]
Sea of Craft offers over a hundred distinct shipbuilding parts to put to work in environments ranging from barren deserts through lush archipelagos and endless open ocean, all built on a realistic physics framework for unlimited creative potential. Join the pantheon of master shipbuilders and satisfy your every whim at the Ship Expo, where you and other captains around the world upload and share the blueprints to your finest works, be they titanic warships or fearsome airborne dragons. Pilot your very own vessels and wander the opens seas, quest for treasure hidden amongst the archipelagos, join hair-raising melee battles and do battle with fierce pirates and sinister monsters from the deep. The immersion knows no bounds!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/fac1f8de8ccff3a2edb4132398571b93e78382b7.jpg[/img]

[b]Rip-roaring Gameplay, Ocean Adventures[/b]
In addition, camera performance and the building system have been improved across the board, alongside quality of life optimizations to stability, performance, Open Sea item distribution and the first-time gameplay experience. As if this wasn't enough, you can now soar higher than ever before using new Flying class shipbuilding parts!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/8396f985909d374f348f3d2d33934118f2490354.jpg[/img]

The future holds even greater promise for Sea of Craft, with new single player content, enhanced social features for the Ship Expo, more automated and Flying parts and much much more!
Sandbox building enthusiasts and veteran sea captains, take out your log books - we set sail this March 10th!

notes.title: Mega version update
notes.notes:
Hello Captains!

It has been a long time since the last updates, we are happy to share the news that we have an mega version to update!

The focus of development revolves around the improvement of the core game experience, new AI-added PVP mode, new air-craft related parts and some suprising things. 

We received lots of feedback and suggestions raised by you guys and fixed or optimized more than 70% of them. At the same time, you can try out the new multiplayer content which was mentioned most from you.

In the future, we will develop more single-player gameplay, more community-based Ship Expo, automatic and flight-related parts. We have basically completed the development of these contents and we can update them in the next versions.

Here are our release notes for this update

[h2]Updates[/h2]
[b]Adds[/b]
1. Add key modification function: You guys can set the button according to your own habits.
2. Add options for frame rate which limit 120 gear or unlimited gear.
3. Add camera controller option: Added camera operation mode based on FPS game control rules
4. Add a shadow cascade option: which can be adjusted to greatly optimize rendering performance.
5. Add the template loading function: if you don't want to take the boat by yourself, you can quickly play the game through the template boats we provide for each mode.
6. Add the function of operation manual: you can quickly view and adjust the case of the ship interaction part.
7. Add price sorting function for Glory Store: although it is not very useful, it still supports everyone to sort and buy.
8. New PVP defense mode: big update!
9. Add function of invite friends in PVP mode: big update! Everyone can invite friends to join the room in PVP.
10. Add custom rule function in PVP mode: big update! Players can adjust room rules when creating a PVP room.
-Set the maximum number of players
-Set the maximum number of parts
-Set the game time limit
-Set race laps in Racing mode.
11. New AI function in PVP mode.
12. New AI in racing mode.
13. New flight-related/blade parts
14. New direction key response of ships in novice guide: big update, when the number of players in the room is not enough, you can play PVP games by adding AI.
15. Delete mandatory process of novice guide: big update, racing mode also supports AI racing.

[b]other:[b]
1. Add flight blade part - with basic aerodynamic algorithm, supporting players to take off in place.
2. Add arrow key response to tutorial ship - tutorial experience optimization.
3. Increase item distribution in Open Sea - Enhanced rewards and experience in Open Sea.
4. The tutorial is removed from the compulsory process - although we always hope that you can play other modes after understanding the basic mechanics of the game, but according to the feedback from community players, we finally turned off the mandatory process of the tutorial to increase the freedom of the game.

[b]Fixed:[/b]
1. Fix the parameter adjustment after multiple parts selections.
2. Fixed the bug that the center of gravity of the ship was randomly positioned after module combined.
3. Optimize the sound effect caused by too many combine and separate  functions
4. Fix the problem that each combine and unbind will cause the object to fall off ( lost joint connection).
5. Fix the issue that the ship in the tutorial cannot be loaded.
6. Fix the bug of overlapping game Background Musics in the boot scene.
7. Fix the bug of tutorial scene camera threading.
8. Fix the interaction bugs between gate and hook claw in Campaign1 Level4.
9. Fix the crystal interaction bug of Campaign1 Level7.
10. Repair Campaign3 Level1 iceberg collision.
11. Fix the bug that PVP players' HP is not synchronized.
12. Fix the bug of template loading failure in Open Sea.
13. Optimize the issue that the number of parts clicked for collection is not limited in Open Sea.
14. Fix the bug of refreshing the level of Open Sea.
...
There are a total of 65 other bugs that affect player experience, game fluency, and interactive feedback


In the future, we will optimize rendering performance as we continue production!

[h2] Thank you for your long-term feedback, suggestions and attention. Your support and affirmation are our motivation.
Finally, we wish you all a happy Chinese new year, happy games and have a happy life[/h2]

notes.title: Update Announcement May 13
notes.notes:
[h2]Foreword[/h2]
After a week of troubleshooting, we are excited to push the latest version live. Some of the high priority problems reported by players in the past week have mostly been fixed in this update.

When the update is complete, you should be able to have a feeling that our game runs much more smoother than before, because we have repaired and refactored a lot of logic in memory management and usage. At the same time, we adjust parameter of several parts which are frequently used to optimize the buoyancy performance. The remaining mparts will be adjusted after fully tested, and will be updated sequently.

At present, we have fixed most of the problems that can be reproduced and located. We have recorded the feedback of some bizarre bugs (such as system compatibility, hardware, etc.), but since there is no other relevant information, we can only rely on our teamates to manually investigate them. But don't worry, any issues we've promised to fix will eventually be resolved.

The focus of the next update will gradually shift to the optimization and iteration of the game experience. We will solve the camera control, construction feel, custom buttons, adsorption and other problems that comes from our players feedback when the game is launched.

notes.title: Update Announcement May 2
notes.notes:
About the camera movement bug, we have searched related issues on the internet and checked a thousand times, but there still comes out that players with this issue. Finally, we searched on Steam community and we found that there are many other games met the similar issue.
From other posts, seems the situation is caused by the Windows 10 installed a device called Microsoft Virtual HID Mouse. Simply remove it can probably solve the problem.

So, the recommended solution step as follows:

0. Unplug all external gaming devices such as joysticks
1. Alt+Enter twice to switch the game back and forth between windowed mode and full screen
2. Change the resolution
3. Switch the input method, if your system has an input method
4. Find the Microsoft Virtual HID Mouse device and remove it
5. If none of the above methods work, please contact us and we will check with you to find out the reason of this weird problem

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h2]Add[/h2]
[olist]

notes.title: Sea of Craft Early Access Version - Coming April 28th
notes.notes:
How we have kept you waiting, oh long-suffering sea captains! We are delighted to announce that the Sea of Craft Early Access Version [b]will be launching at 9:00pm (PT), Thursday 28th April! [/b]The Early Access version price will be discounted 10% for the first week only! A world of shipbuilding high jinks and ocean adventures awaits you. Save the date and dust off your charts - it’s time to set sail!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/990920/_/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/d0fce4f27dac9c44361829e5ce67485c9da98dcc.jpg[/img]

[h2]Introducing Sea of Craft[/h2]
Sea of Craft is a maritime sandbox construction game with realistic simulated physics. The EA version includes the full building experience and blueprint sharing features plus single player levels, multiplayer and PvE. Choose from hundreds of individual building parts to create unique and elaborate builds all of your very own. Ignite your intrigue with head-scratching single player levels and challenge yourself to reach the top of the ranking tables. Take to the Open Sea, where dread pirates, mysterious islands and gruesome sea monsters await you!

[h3]Physics-based Construction - share your builds with the world![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/cecc71ac6845bc016d5cb241822784c54f365aed.png[/img]

Choose from a boundless ocean, a desert plain or a tranquil archipelago and set the stage for your building endeavours. Enjoy realistic simulated physics and building mechanics designed to give you as much freedom as possible. Equip your build with armor plating, mobility parts, weapons and more, and paint it with colorful sprays. With hundreds of parts to choose from your builds will be truly unique. Craft anything, from sea-skimming hovercrafts to ground-rumbling tanks; from majestic dragons to ocean abominations. Satisfy your building desires in any domain, be it sea, land or sky.

[h3]Vibrant Single Player - adventure and upgrade![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/72deab86e8f2e5def39c6af72deaaa7fdde32fca.png[/img]

Fancy a brainteaser? Check out our intricately designed themed single player levels! Underpinned by a smooth linear progression system, our single player levels take you step by step through a range of challenges that test not only your building ingenuity but also your piloting and problem-solving abilities. Grasping a cannonball with an iron hook? Or saving a group of baby alligators left adrift? It’s all here in Sea of Craft!

Alternatively, take to the high seas and do battle with fierce pirates and gruesome monsters. The risks are great - but so are the rewards. Plunder their closely guarded treasure and use it to improve your builds. Master multiplayer battles, fishing and racing and crown yourself king of the high seas!

[h3]Realistic Ocean Environment - ultimate immersion[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/03b14f2247fe706d7bff8c97425c492515cee0ba.png[/img]

Sea of Craft is a fantastic immersive experience couched in an artistic, realistic ocean environment with exquisite textures and therapeutic sound design. Set sail and feel the ocean waves rippling beneath your feet. Feel the wind in your hair and hear the ocean lapping peacefully against your hull. The countless archipelagos scattered across Beela conceal more than meets the eye. Remnants of lost civilisations from the Middle Ages to the Steam Age rupture and litter the seascape like ancient tectonic plates, confounding historians and sea captains alike!

Throughout the EA phase, we will be working diligently to optimise and improve game content based on your feedback. The full release version will feature additional building parts, combat gameplay and more - a must-have for all you hardcore shipbuilders and naval commanders!

Plot a course and follow our socials!

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/seaofcraft/

notes.title: Sea of Craft Update is here!
notes.notes:
It's been a long time, dear captains~~~

[b]The Sea of Craft are coming with a big wave of updates!!![/b]

During the previous tests, we[b]collected and listened carefully to the massive opinions of the captains[/b]. After combining the development schedule and the priority of feedbacks, we have successively implemented[b]frame selection parts, batch move parts and a slew of "Serious Shipbuilding Parts"[/b] that all new content captains have been waiting for! The EA version is about to be released, and we will do our best to let everyone enjoy the fun in the South Beela Sea!

This time Sea of Craft once again brought you a large number of epic updates in creative mode, including [b] generating custom parts, one-click copy function of frame selection parts, import and export of msoc parts set, and a new creative mode scene desert oasis! [/b]

Now, let's introduce the specific content of this update to you~

[h2] New function: custom size part generation, greatly optimize the performance of large-scale construction! [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/41419d3cadd08ae206ff33adf7ed34cc423afbe3.gif[/img]

You can customize the size of the part. Using this part to build can greatly reduce the repetitive work of building and improve performance. For example, in the past, when you needed to build a 100*100 chassis, you needed to manually piece together wooden rafts, but when you use the custom part [b], you only need to enter the length, width and height to generate it with one click[/b], and the generated part will be regarded as a part so that greatly improved build performance!

[h2]New function: multi-part selection and directly copy[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/acbb241808a5017b4417f0f0535ae45fa06c4df0.gif[/img]

Added Ctrl+D shortcut so you can [b]copy the selected part with one click[/b], reducing a lot of repetitive work when using a certain structure repeatedly!

[h2]New feature: part set import and export (msoc file)[/h2]

On the basis of the original blueprint format soc, a new export format msoc has been added, which can be simply understood as a microsoc blueprint or a mod blueprint. Considering that there may be some highly reusable structures in the actual construction process, repeated manual construction of structures will consume the patience of captains!

This function can realize [b]frame selection of multiple objects and export them as a structure group with one click[/b] (not limited by core block). The main purpose of the msoc part set function is to make it more convenient to spread the structure group among the core players. This function will not be embedded in the Ship Expo sharing, and we will consider adding it to the steamworkshop in the later stage!

[h2]New scene: Desert Oasis in Creative mode[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/d0f040a2c4f978abeb0c98cffa6082ec6a8ba964.gif[/img]

Updated the screen performance, rich desert materials, added [b]pools and vegetation[/b]
New destructible scene objects: (test function) The altar in the oasis and the red pillars near the playground[b]can be realistically destroyed[/b] (there are rigid bodies and linked structures to transmit power). We will decide to add more content in the subsequent version based on the real-time fragmentation of the scene according to the feedback from you captains on the destruction effect!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/0ea0bf1c5f6be654cd97d75b3c8da97e474128fb.gif[/img]

notes.title: Captain's Update #6
notes.notes:
Happy Tuesday, crafters!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/f9ea806c9cacffee3f843428bfab2da78429f2ff.png[/img]

Here is a taster of some things we've been working on, straight from the Captain's Deck. We think you're going to love them.

[h2]5 NEW CHAPTERS[/h2]
5 new chapters for you to flex those creative muscles and get accustom to the game. Today we are introducing [b]Beeladdins Law[/b], [b]The Floating Bridge[/b], [b]Double Planks[/b], [b]Fly Across[/b] & [b]Wooden Bridge[/b]!

[h2]NEW POWER COMPONENT: SAILS[/h2]
Build your dream ship and take to the seas with style with a new power component!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/9e0b3919db4e62a8aeb47733751fc8250ce1eacf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/e975f6e65ba804a232485a619a16755d7bdffed0.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/9e0b3919db4e62a8aeb47733751fc8250ce1eacf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/e975f6e65ba804a232485a619a16755d7bdffed0.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/9e0b3919db4e62a8aeb47733751fc8250ce1eacf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/e975f6e65ba804a232485a619a16755d7bdffed0.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/9e0b3919db4e62a8aeb47733751fc8250ce1eacf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/e975f6e65ba804a232485a619a16755d7bdffed0.png[/img][/url]
As famously said, [i]“Wherever we want to go, we’ll go.”[/i]. Never has a truer word been spoken. Not only do these sails look stylish, they also act as a power component. Our testers loved getting creative using these and taking advantage of the seas. Check out some of our favourite creations using Sails:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/2e2924cc92735cfdcb5c11018d3bdcfcc99c63e6.png[/img]
[i]Pirate Ship[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/8afb03b262b5a005126243e296049e9389e641e4.png[/img]
[i]Mini Speedster[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/c68c95ebb8214c2b544a44f6e38c2f23d4dabd44.png[/img]
[i]The Small Galleon[/i]

[h2]4 NEW WHEELS[/h2]
Take your combat and exploration to the land with [b]new wheels[/b]!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/e61f46f184d1eeec2e55afc0543786b0cac5dee5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/d649953bbd5bf70195ad03310e80cf2c0c60cd46.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/a663740e419c8436e36334dd5b28599134c9fe99.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/4fec0a65611200c580ce3558d6e04ab13ec8a7dd.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/78f3b1fd55d98317334c439a5ba1d275f10ef715.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/95475a8fa4d557a6785091d728f81cc0c4eb6f93.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/05a4065415bd05d62b9023252622c2de41cbc3e3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/21229a7a8056da4e00dd8e30aa503fbfd9217b33.png[/img][/url]
During closed beta we were blown away by the creativity of our community. With this in mind, we've added a new selection of rubber wheels, each with their own properties. We've already heard whispers of player's creating TANKS and BATTLE TANKS! We can't wait to see how they're put to use.

[h2]NEW WEAPONS: SAW CANNON & SALVO[/h2]
New weapons go BOOM. Meet the [b]Saw Cannon[/b] and [b]Salvo[/b].

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/354ecbae7d67a05262e3ec2b9b055cb4a76c9e9e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/f890b5bf4a19a3575af8549deef02a5a7ec0b10d.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/df0910858f5adf2ee4278283a9c7c4ffd49e7418.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/8fcf9485e09ffaa78cd949c56857adf6ad3835fc.png[/img][/url]
Let's be honest, one of the most fun things to do is destroy everything. Especially with the beautiful particle physics we've got. That's why we've added even more new weapons.

New Weapons = More Destruction = More Fun!

[h2]MORE NEW THINGS[/h2]
[list]
[*]Hull Orientation Tool - Now adjust ship’s orientation at the click of a button.
[*]Improved PvE Open Seas Tutorial.
[*]Improved PvP Multiplayer Interface - New UI & Rules.
[*]UI Bug Fixes & Improvements
[*]Localisation Fixes
[*]Fixed Parts HP Bug
[*]Additional quality of life improvements and bug fixes.
[/list]

Phew, that's everything for now... Let us know what you think! The support for our game has been so positive so far. As a small indie dev, hearing from players means the world to us. We're always listening and open to feedback. We can't wait to get these changes in your hands.

See you on the seas soon...
Over 'n' Out!

notes.title: Dev Update: Captain's Log #5
notes.notes:
News just in from the Captain’s Log! Deafening crashes heard in the distance of the Beela Seas reveal many big changes to have taken place recently.

[b]DEMON ALTARS[/b]
Mysterious altars have been discovered in the Open Sea. Rumour has it that those brave enough to touch them will be blessed (or cursed) with godlike powers...

[b]PIRATE CAMPS & STRONGHOLDS[/b]
The barrier of the Beela Sea has broken - and PIRATES have invaded. They used wooden planks to make various sea camps! Only the bravest can take them over and claim this as their own. Once a stronghold has been taken over, stop off at them to repair or upgrade.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/d938dc181d66c1d5fafc3bd94b94e85c42d9c002.png[/img]

[b]CAMP SHOPS[/b]
After the pirate ships have been cleaned up in the camps, shops will be opened to the natives of Beela following their surrender. With daily deals and special items for sale, crafters will be able to visit these to buy additional upgrades at a fair price.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/0259540a78e5c4000814bf36e07ebe9d695fe831.png[/img]

[b]PVP ARENA[/b]
The people of Beela found that being friendly could not be exchanged for peace, so they accelerated the construction of ‘The Arena’ and regularly held combat activities to screen the design and driving of the most powerful warships in the Beela waters. Feeling brave?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/0516dfa030edbe84bed3744b085a5ff7096b8189.png[/img]

[b]NEW RESOURCES & WEAPONS[/b]
New materials were also discovered floating in the seas, including STEEL PARTS and RAPID FIRE WEAPONS! Many thrifty crafters have already started to put these to good use in upgrading their vessels. Here are a few:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/8d6b1e9e4761311954c6b69de22a97eacc69a7cd.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/85a006954045969a4ceadb3bab23e9064b49f1ba.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/261f9057b6baef5d16fb221cab307410ae041ba8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/68ba0b43c45632ca5b5f87f0250359c942f5ee7c.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/f6da127cae437d3cf9b60baa917a6ecdaab27093.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/c54a78c3e65b01e74a301e22c237bfc05c2a0fad.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/dedddb95c524b0836f787fa651ebea5a4583c7a1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/be2bd6f3b014786baa98169a45842d7c0a6eed89.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/38fa9a40353c1420ff65ee1d33a59e451ba3c99d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/bfde5f58bf872b5fa7dafc0913f4d14333cc0830.png[/img][/url]

[b]IMPROVED USER INTERFACE[/b]
Based on feedback from our crafters, the user interface has been redesigned from the ground up. Giving the whole overall look and feel of the menus a more modern and stylish feel.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/d60ab94f2585ff903073cb6a45a000144025307f.png[/img]

[b]REPAIRED SAILS[/b]
Back by popular demand! We hired the finest captains out there to work on repairing the sails. The team has finally found the perfect balance between difficulty, control and authenticity to the sails technology.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/734898e16b6b7a8e63a6b79e420c8db053b794c0.png[/img]

[b]BOSS SHIP[/b]
A boss-like enemy has also been sighted by some explorers. Reported to be causing terror and trouble in the Open Sea. More information on this as it becomes available…
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544216/e418b8bb4a8d0f9491df9d23bf03e290124d0143.png[/img]

Until next time, captains!
Over 'n' out.
